notes.title: Patch Notes #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/73a151f39167cf2759428c5a52c9aa10f8d995e9.jpg[/img]

We are also changing game title to Secret Saga Xamadeon Stone because we think it reflects story better.

notes.title: End Of Saga
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/13d937645928ec8b8e49d3f16c777eb98bb54ec7.jpg[/img]

We have come to the Hidden Saga's final after 1 year of development. Our story end with this update. We hope you enjoy the final! We also wanted to thank you who supported us through Early Access.

Game is not finished entirely. Your feedbacks are important to us. After evaluating feedbacks we will announce release date.

Warning: You can play last episode only in English and Turkish for now. Translations will be added.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] New level added! Tavuri Castle.
[*] Added 5 new puzzle levels for Castle level.
[*] Fixed some translation issues.
[*] Fixed some image issues.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added 5 new puzzle levels for Castle level.

notes.title: New update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/1fe3d39e53505625a03b0dc8d89fef4aac3c1c49.png[/img]

Hello folks! You couldn't hear from us for a long time. That's because I lost my beloved grandfather and grandmother in two months. I needed some time to recover. I am very sorry that I couldn't let you guys know. I am fine now and have some good news! Color level update is available! I hope you guys enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/846d925207d46cc04addacd8d25a36ca48325b9f.png[/img]
Changelog
[list]
[*] One color level added
[*] Map-key problem solved.
[*] Game crash fixed.
[*] Various bug and layer fixes.
[/list]
